我的生活与购物(My Life and shopping): 一篇关于购物消费的A2短文:汤姆与杰克的经历和小计划。
The weather was rainy that day. Last Tuesday, Tom and Jack went to the supermarket. They took many photos at the shopping mall. In fact, the department store has six floors.
Tom is going to travel to Xi'an in October. Both of them like noodles and juice. Tom hopes to visit Xi'an one day. Also, travel insurance covers lost bags.
Tom wrote about the day in the diary. It takes twenty minutes to get to the supermarket by bike. Tom likes rainy days best. The card reader timed out twice.
Life is full of small surprises. Tom and Jack had great fun there. Tom wants to be a nurse in the future.
